text:
Jamie L: Heads-up — we're kicking off the acme-migration quota sweep across three cloud accounts. Need GPU (p4d/p4/ga100), vCPU, ENI/NIC counts, and public IP/NAT allocations increased before the dry-run next week. Opening tickets and tracking here.
Alex C: thanks. which accounts and regions?
Jamie L: AWS prod-account (us-west-2), Azure tenant-acme-prod (westus2), GCP org-acme (us-central1).
Siva R: any specific numbers? we should give them expected peak and baseline.
Jamie L: rough request: AWS: +40 p4d vCPUs (10 instances), ENI limit +50, Elastic IPs +60; Azure: quota for NC T4 v3 GPUs 12 -> 30, IP public +50; GCP: A100 GPUs 0 -> 8, external IP quota +40. Also bump regional vCPU quotas to cover autoscaling.
Maria P: can we use burst capacity instead of permanent raises? acme wants short-term reserved for initial migration window (2 weeks).
Jamie L: prefer permanent for predictable runs, but include temporary burst option in requests. mention cost approval attached.
Alex C: filing AWS case now. sending AWS case id in thread.
Ops Bot: New ticket created: AWS Case 12345678901 — service-quotas request. Status: awaiting AWS review.
Jamie L: great, paste the case link if you have it.
Alex C: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases/#/case/?caseId=12345678901 — emailed AWS TAM, asked for cell escalation.
Cloud Support (AWS): Hi team — we've received case 12345678901. Assigned engineer: Priya K. ETA for initial response: 4 business hours. Please provide projected vCPU and ENI utilization graphs if available.
Siva R: attaching quick util snapshot for us-west-2 (last 30 days).
Siva R: ```
# aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --metric-name CPUUtilization --namespace AWS/EC2 --start-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z --period 3600 --statistics Average
(omitted for thread)```
Jamie L: Azure case opened too. Case#: 9876543210.
Cloud Support (Azure): Azure support case 9876543210 created. Request routed to quota management. We requested subscription owner confirmation and a short business justification doc.
Maria P: I'll draft the justification (migration timeline, security posture, cost commit) and upload.
Jamie L: GCP case created: 555777333. Support portal link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/555777333
Cloud Support (GCP): Noted. For GCP A100 quota requests, we need project-level billing enabled and a 30-day usage forecast. If you can provide expected node counts per day that helps accelerate approval.
Alex C: quick question — should we request regional static IP increases or per-subnet NAT gateway increases? acme uses NAT gateways in each VPC.
Siva R: ask for both. NAT gateway public IP quota (per-region) is usually the blocker for ephemeral clusters.
Jamie L: Agreed — asked for NAT public IP +50 per region in the Azure/AWS requests.
Maria P: cost note — if they approve permanent increases, committed spend estimated ~$18k/month for reserved instances during migration window. tagging and chargeback will be required.
Alex C: AWS engineer asked for justification doc and sample CloudFormation snippet showing ENI count. Posting CF snippet.
Alex C: ```
Resources:
  WorkerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      NetworkInterfaces:
        - DeviceIndex: 0
          SubnetId: subnet-abc123
          AssociatePublicIpAddress: true
      InstanceType: p4d.24xlarge
```
Jamie L: also asked AWS to consider soft-limit increase first, with fallback to spot capacity if they can't hit it by Friday.
Cloud Support (AWS): Priya K here — we can try for soft increase. If we hit manual review, we can escalate to TAM-led phone call.
Ops Bot: Reminder: migration dry-run scheduled 2026-03-22 09:00 PT. Need quota confirmed 48h before.
Siva R: pinging @Priya K (AWS) for escalation if needed.
Cloud Support (Azure): We raised urgent flag on Azure case 9876543210. Support agent: Carlos M. He requested subscription GUID and billing contact.
Maria P: provided subscription GUID in secure attachment; billing contact is billing@acme.com.
Jamie L: action items: Alex follow up AWS, Maria finalize Azure justification, Siva prepare GCP usage forecast. If any provider asks for a phone escalation, I'll be on the call (Jamie L).
Alex C: updated AWS case with utilization graphs and CF snippet.
Cloud Support (GCP): Case 555777333 updated — reviewer asked for 7-day rolling forecast. We set priority to P2 for quota requests.
Maria P: uploaded justification doc to the ticket and to the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/acme-migration/quota-justification.pdf :thumbsup:
Jamie L: thanks. please report back here once any case changes state.
Siva R: marking this thread as primary coordination. Will create a follow-up thread for IP provisioning once quotas are approved.
Ops Bot: Case status summary (automated): AWS 12345678901 — In Review; Azure 9876543210 — In Review; GCP 555777333 — Pending Info.
Alex C: if any provider stalls, fallback plan is to split traffic across two regions and use temporary rented capacity from partner. cost impact ~+25%.
Jamie L: noted. closing loop — we'll reconvene if anything blocks the dry-run. :wave:
